title: 春の七草と七草がゆ
subject_en: Japanese seven spring herbs (seri, nazuna, gogyo, hakobera, hotokenoza, suzuna turnip, suzushiro daikon) and the seven-herb rice porridge, Japanese ink-and-colour style, each plant shown whole with leaves and roots on its own, centred Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: セリ・ナズナ・ゴギョウなど春の七草と、七草がゆ・土鍋・まな板の場面12点の素材です。1月7日の行事食の案内に使えます。
items: a bunch of Japanese parsley (seri) with green leaves and white roots
a shepherd's purse (nazuna) plant with heart-shaped seed pods and roots
a cudweed (gogyo) plant with soft white-grey leaves and small yellow flowers
a chickweed (hakobera) plant with small round leaves and tiny white flowers
a nipplewort (hotokenoza) rosette flat on the ground with small leaves
a small white turnip with its green leaves attached
a white daikon radish with its green leaves attached
all seven spring herbs tied together in a loose bundle
a bowl of seven-herb rice porridge with green flecks and a wooden spoon
an earthenware pot with lid half-open and steam, with a ladle
a wooden cutting board with chopped green herbs and a kitchen knife
a bamboo basket filled with spring herbs on a cloth
